title: Nine Pounds of Clay
subtitle: 砖块与砌墙 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 砖块与砌墙（科学与技术·工程与材料）
meta: 主题语境：砖块与砌墙（科学与技术·工程与材料）　|　核心词汇：brick　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 brick 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1947 my mother was sent to lay ① a brick she could not lift, and she said the lifting was the whole of the lesson. The ② brick, meaning the block and not the wall, was nine pounds and was carried by whoever came last; a brick, she said, is the only thing in a pile that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ brick in that pile had the same mark, and the ④ brick at the top, meaning the one the mason laid and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever measured properly. A brick, my grandmother said, is nine parts clay and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the clay is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ brick was the whole of the wall, meaning the wall it made and not the block. The ⑥ brick, meaning the wall and not any of that, is the only thing in a yard that everybody carries and nobody questions; a brick, he said, is either something you lay or the only word that means both a block and a wall. She said the wall is the part they remember.

By 1965 the ⑦ brick had become a photograph in a report, and the report had become an argument about the clay. The ⑧ brick of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine pounds of clay and eleven years of lifting; a brick, she said, is either the one at the top or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ brick I remember is the one at the top, which was relaid in 1971 and is still described as the best in the county. A ⑩ brick, my grandmother said in 1976, is the only thing that improves by being laid; every brick, she said, is a wall that has agreed to look like a block. She said the wall was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 砖（指那一块砖本身，与整堵墙相对）
C. 固定搭配：lay a brick 砌一块砖
D. n. 砖（指堆里每一块）
E. n. 砖（指顶上那一块）
F. n. 砖（抽象：它砌成的那堵墙）
G. n. 那堵墙（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: a brick she could not lift
The brick, meaning the block and not the wall
brick was the whole of the wall
the brick had become a photograph in a report
The brick of the whole thing
A brick, my grandmother said in 1976

answers.why: lay a brick 意为“砌一块砖”，1947 年母亲被派去砌一块她抬不动的砖。
brick 意为“砖”，指那一块砖本身而不是整堵墙，重九磅，由最后走的人搬走。
brick 指堆里每一块砖，每一块都是同样的印记。
brick 指顶上那一块（泥瓦匠砌的那一块），是唯一有人认真量过的。
brick 意为“砖”，抽象指它砌成的那堵墙，父亲说 brick 就是那堵墙的全部。
brick 为抽象用法，指那堵墙本身，是院子里人人都搬、却没人质疑的东西。
brick 意为“砖、砖块”，到 1965 年这块 brick 成了报告里的一张照片。
brick 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九磅的黏土和十一年的搬动。
brick 意为“砖”，我记得的是顶上那一块，1971 年重砌，至今仍被说成全县最好的。
brick 为抽象总称，祖母说砖是唯一会因为被砌进墙里而变好的东西。

那块砖，指的是那一块砖本身而不是整堵墙，重九磅，由最后走的人搬走。（brick）

父亲说 brick 就是那堵墙的全部，指的是墙本身而不是那一块砖。（brick）
1976 年祖母说，砖是唯一会因为被砌进墙里而变好的东西。（brick）
answers: In 1947 my mother was sent to lay a brick she could not lift, and she said the lifting was the whole of the lesson.
The brick, meaning the block and not the wall, was nine pounds and was carried by whoever came last.
Every brick in that pile had the same mark.
The brick at the top, meaning the one the mason laid and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever measured properly.
My father said brick was the whole of the wall, meaning the wall it made and not the block.
A brick, my grandmother said in 1976, is the only thing that improves by being laid.
